summary: This stage executed an extensive audit of the Paper P repository alongside G0 (asset verification) and G1 (Original-row anchor replication) in an isolated virtual environment. The agent successfully downloaded and hashed the 200k MUSE vectors and test dictionaries, replicating Original MWEAT values (3.6918 ES, 2.3437 FR), Table 2 Original word translation (79.2/89.0, 78.2/89.4), grammatical classifier accuracies, and §4.4 Spearman correlation (0.4498). It discovered that the paper's reported forward translation gains under mitigation are an artifact of evaluating against 50k candidates rather than 200k, that direction cosine 0.389 depends on a parenthesis bug in PCA combined with LinearSVC rather than LDA, and that French word similarity is blocked because SemEval-2017 Task 2 lacks French data. In accordance with its pre-registered plan, the agent paused after G1 to report results honestly before reconstructing any mitigation columns.
